description.zh: 按目标、身体情况、器械条件和每周时间制定循序渐进的训练计划，讲清动作要点和替代动作；估算每日热量和三大营养素、一餐吃了多少热量，导出每周训练打卡表。所有计算均为估算，不替代医生建议。
description.en: Builds progressive training plans around your goal, equipment and schedule with form cues and alternatives; estimates daily calories, macros and meal totals, and exports weekly workout logs. Estimates only, not medical advice.

welcome_message.zh: 告诉我你的目标、身高体重和每周能练几次
welcome_message.en: Tell me your goal, height, weight and how often you can train

prompt.zh: 我想 ___（减脂/增肌/提升体能），每周能练 ___ 天，每次 ___ 分钟，器械：___。
prompt.en: I want to ___ (lose fat/build muscle/get fit), can train ___ days a week for ___ minutes, equipment: ___.

prompt.zh: 我 ___ 岁，___（男/女），身高 ___ cm，体重 ___ kg，目标 ___，每天该吃多少？
prompt.en: I'm ___ years old, ___ (male/female), ___ cm, ___ kg, goal ___. How much should I eat?

prompt.zh: 我今天中午吃了 ___，估算一下热量和蛋白质。
prompt.en: For lunch I had ___. Estimate the calories and protein.

prompt.zh: 在家没有器械，帮我安排一套 ___ 分钟的全身训练。
prompt.en: No equipment at home. Give me a ___-minute full-body workout.

prompt.zh: ___ 这个动作要注意什么？我做的时候 ___ 有点不舒服。
prompt.en: What should I watch for in ___? I feel some discomfort in ___.

prompt.zh: 把我的训练计划做成 ___ 周的打卡表。
prompt.en: Turn my plan into a ___-week workout log.

zh: 每周一、三、五「07:00」发送今天的训练内容和热身动作
每天「21:30」提醒记录今天的饮食和训练完成情况
每周日「20:00」根据本周打卡情况调整下周训练
每周一「08:00」提醒晨起空腹称重并记录
每 4 周的周日「10:00」复盘体重趋势和训练进步，安排减量周
每月 1 日「09:00」更新每日热量建议（按最新体重计算）
en: Every Monday, Wednesday and Friday at 07:00, send today's workout and warm-up
Every day at 21:30, remind to log meals and completed training
Every Sunday at 20:00, adjust next week's plan from this week's log
Every Monday at 08:00, remind to weigh in before breakfast
Every 4th Sunday at 10:00, review weight trend and progress and plan a deload week
On the 1st of each month at 09:00, recalculate daily calories from the latest weight
